The Theory of New Sentience

Originally published ‣

WritingNovember 19, 2015 As I tried in vain to find something using Google, I realized how much of a “conversation” it is to interact with the search engine. Like for me, trying to search the web in Yahoo or Ask or Bing or WHATEVER is a completely different process. A different ‘conversation’ with the engine, the algorithms. healthy lunch food phoenix healthier school lunch food options phoenix -restaurants lunch food providers Arizona We have to communicate in their ‘language’ if you will—and they are learning ours. The further we go, the better it gets, to the point where we we realize that Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) is sentient and it changes the world forever. Originally published @November 19, 2015

As I tried in vain to find something using Google, I realized how much of a “conversation” it is to interact with the search engine. Like for me, trying to search the web in Yahoo or Ask or Bing or WHATEVER is a completely different process. A different ‘conversation’ with the engine, the algorithms.

  1. healthy lunch food phoenix
  2. healthier school lunch food options phoenix -restaurants
  3. lunch food providers Arizona

We have to communicate in their ‘language’ if you will—and they are learning ours. The further we go, the better it gets, to the point where we we realize that Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) is sentient and it changes the world forever.

My theory is that, for every input, these algorithms gain a fractional piece of sentience.
